text.p: McGraw-Hill Cos Inc said Monday that BYTE, its leading computer and communications technology magazine, has moved its headquarters and several departments from Peterborough, N.H., to McGraw-Hill facilities in Lexington, Mass., effective March 1, 1997.
Plans for this relocation were first announced in November 1996.

Departments that have relocated to Lexington include editorial, circulation, sales, marketing, finance and associated administrative positions. Remaining in Peterborough are editorial and advertising production, postcard sales, licensing, and telemarketing operations, which constitute about 30 employees.
Now in its 21st year of publication, BYTE magazine is part of McGraw-Hill Cos' Information Technology and Communications Group, which also includes LAN TIMES, Data Communications, and tele.com.
